\/\u003E\n\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E65 year old male ,farmer by occupation was brought to the casuality\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;in an altered state with a low G C S \u0026nbsp;since 1 day.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;involuntary movements involving left UL and LL since 1day.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; slurred speech since 1day.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nIn view of low gcs patient was intubated and put on ventilator (ACMV\/ VC )\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nOn history taken from the attendars ,he is a. chronic alcoholic consumes almost 90ml\/day and occasional smoker ,farmer by occupation who works hard enough under scrotching sun to earn his daily bread , this man was apparently asymptomatic 4yrs back then\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: blue;\"\u003EIN \u0026nbsp;2016\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003Ewas diagnosed with diabetes mellitus when he visited the hospital with complaints of low grade fever \u0026nbsp; then on \u0026nbsp;was on oral hypoglycemic agents for 2months later on was shifted to insulin injections as his sugars weren’t under control with OHA.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"color: purple; font-weight: bold; text-decoration: underline;\"\u003EIN 2017 \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003Ehe revisited hospital with complaints of pedal oedema extending upto knees and facial puffiness ,neck pain ,on evaluation he was found to be hypertensive and his renal parameters were deranged,as the patient denied admission ,was put on supportive treatment (?LASIX) and sent home.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"color: #f6b26b; font-weight: bold; text-decoration: underline;\"\u003EIN JANUARY 2018 \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003EHe developed slurring of speech with slight deviation of mouth after intake of binge of alcohol \u0026nbsp;following which he visited nearby hospital ,advised for an MRI brain which showed \u0026nbsp;infarcts as told by the attendars ,was put on medication (??) and he recovered within a day,\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDue to repeated visits to the hospital ,he completely gave up alcohol as he must have thought that alcohol could \u0026nbsp;be a triggering factor for his morbidities which could possibly be true.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cspan style=\"color: #134f5c;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EIN AUGUST \u0026nbsp;2018\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E \u0026nbsp;He again visited hospital with complaints of\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;fever of high grade since 4 days\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;decreased urine output\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; neck stiffness\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHe was admitted and on evaluation his\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; sugars were high,\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; CUE showed albumin 2+,sugars 3+,pus cells plenty appearance cloudy\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Hba1c \u0026nbsp;8.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Urine for ketone bodies negative\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; ESR 110mm\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; blood urea 108\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; ser creatinine 3.7\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; USG abdomen bilateral RPD changes grade 3\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; serum albumin 2.7\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; xray cervical spine findings were consistent with spondylitis\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nProvisional diagnosis of DIABETIC NEPHROPATHY with UNCONTROLLED SUGARS and with DIABETIC FOOT was made ,was in hospital for 5days ,sugars and bp was under check,was put on supportive management and was discharged at request.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nand then on \u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: orange;\"\u003E16th of APRIL \/\u003E\nSo if we\u0026nbsp; review the entire history of this patient , still there are lot of doubts which are clinching our brains , though we know the immediate cause of death ,we are still not sure of the antecedent cause of death, and when we ourselves are not sure of it then how can we explain it to the patient attendars which is there right to know,\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nIs there something which we could have done prior which must have save this old man ,\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nthe reason for making this blog is to review and rereview the history and the course of events occured during his stay in the hospital so that we could find answer to our every single doubt and can hopefully execute it on other patients,\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;many of the queries are still unanswered.\u003Cbr
